_readme: Speech-to-text configuration. One file, read by the web app, the CLI (tools/transcribe.py) and the Android bridge, so the three never drift apart. Edit here, not in code.

web._readme: Browser Web Speech API. No dependency, no key, no server. Chrome, Edge and Safari support it; Firefox does not, so the UI falls back to typing with an explanation.
web.unsupported_message: این مرورگر گفتار را تشخیص نمی‌دهد — تایپ کن یا از کروم استفاده کن. / This browser has no speech recognition — type instead, or use Chrome.

android._readme: Uses the on-device RecognizerIntent that ships with Android, so there is no model to download and no API key. Falls back to the web engine when the device has no recogniser.

cli._readme: Optional local backends for tools/transcribe.py. It probes what is installed and says so plainly rather than failing quietly. faster-whisper is the best quality per watt; vosk is the lightest; the openai-whisper package is the reference implementation.

privacy._readme: Recording notes. Web and Android recognition may be sent to the browser/OS vendor's service - the UI says so the first time. Nothing is uploaded by this project.
privacy.notice: صدا فقط برای تبدیل به متن استفاده می‌شود. / Audio is used only to turn speech into text.
